title: Stalk of a finite direct image of an etale sheaf of sets
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite morphism of schemes [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], $H$ a sheaf of sets on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], with direct image $f_*H$, $(f_*H)(V)=H(V\times_YX)$ for $V$ in $Y_{\Et}$, and $\bar y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. Let $P(\bar y)$ be the set of geometric points $\bar x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ with $f\circ\bar x=\bar y$. For $\bar x\in P(\bar y)$ let $r_{\bar x}:(f_*H)_{\bar y}\to H_{\bar x}$ (stalks of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]) send the germ at a pointed etale neighbourhood $(V,\bar v)$ of $\bar y$ of $s\in(f_*H)(V)=H(V\times_YX)$ to the germ of $s$ at the pointed etale neighbourhood $(V\times_YX,(\bar v,\bar x))$ of $\bar x$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then $P(\bar y)$ is finite and the map\n$$(r_{\bar x})_{\bar x\in P(\bar y)}:(f_*H)_{\bar y}\longrightarrow\prod_{\bar x\in P(\bar y)}H_{\bar x}$$\nis bijective.
